//: Settings profile for opening-night monitor sessions (launched by scripts/opening-night-monitor-launch.js as: claude --model fable --dangerously-skip-permissions --settings .claude/opening-night-monitor-settings.json). Bypass suppresses permission PROMPTS (an unattended session must never hang on one); these deny rules outrank bypass. Deliberately LOOSER than autonomous-settings.json — the monitor's whole job is pushing data fixes and dispatching pipeline workflows — so only the genuinely irreversible/audience-facing actions are denied: broadcast sends, force pushes, Vercel token ops, and edits to this file / the launcher itself (a session must not widen its own cage). IMPORTANT: prefix deny rules are DEFENSE-IN-DEPTH, not a guarantee — path variants (./scripts, absolute) are covered below but a determined invocation (cd first, node -e, raw curl to Resend) is not expressible here. The primary control for CLAUDE.md rule 17 is the seed prompt's hard ban + the fact that broadcast sends have no legitimate monitor use; owner report emails go through owner-alert-router. gh workflow run stays ALLOWED but rate-capped by ~/.claude/hooks/gh-poll-block.sh (25/hr) — the session's Phase-0 preflight verifies that hook is actually loaded and stops if not.
